title: The Café Terrace and its Goddesses
description: When Hayato's grandmother passed, he planned to sell her rundown café by the shore—not realizing that it was being run by five young women who call themselves her family?! Their desperation to keep the café open convinces Hayato to give it a shot...but even their best intentions might not be enough to make it work! And can he even work with these five unruly women? No matter what, he's got his work cut out for him! A fun new romcom by the author of Fuuka and Suzuka!
author: Kouji Seo
